stemMd: A task takes 18 worker-hours. Two identical workers each work for 3 hours, then one continues alone. Assuming constant rates, how many more hours are required?
explanationMd: Two workers for three hours supply six worker-hours. Twelve worker-hours remain. A single worker needs twelve additional hours at the stated rate.

distractorRationale.a: This is the work completed together, not the remaining time alone.
distractorRationale.b: This halves the original workload without tracking completed hours.
distractorRationale.d: Two workers completed six worker-hours, not three.
distractorRationale.e: Some of the work has already been completed.

independentSolve.workingNotes: Blind re-solve in the 5 November 2026 AI audit of this expansion (the review packet held no key, explanation or distractor notes; status "solved-blind"; it checked for competing defensible answers and flagged none): 18workerhoursminus2times3=12, onecontinuing12hours.
